info.name: Quartermaster API
info.description: Generated from /api/openapi.json by `npm run postman:build`. Run the whole collection (Runner, or `npm run test:api`) from top to bottom: it signs in as the demo volunteer and treasurer and checks that signed-out calls, bad input and the wrong role are refused. It never moves money. Sandbox only.

request.description: Health check
This document

exec: pm.test("200 for PayPal client token", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Browser client token for the PayPal JS SDK v6

item.name: Webhook without a PayPal signature is rejected

exec: pm.test("400 for Webhook without a PayPal signature is rejected", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

request.description:
PayPal webhook receiver

Signature verified with PayPal, stored by event id before processing (duplicates ignored).

item.name: MCP without a key is refused

exec: pm.test("401 for MCP without a key is refused", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

request.description:
MCP server (streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC)

Tools: list_mandates, search_products, check_purchase, request_purchase, search_policy, get_trust_receipt, submit_reimbursement. None can pay.

Chat with the purchasing agent

AI SDK v6 UI message stream. Body: { id, messages } as sent by useChat. The agent can search, dry-run and propose; it cannot pay.

exec: pm.test("401 for Create PayPal order", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

request.description:
Create the PayPal order for an approved proposal

Approver only. The mandate is re-checked first; PayPal-Request-Id = order-<id>.

Capture after the approver pays in the PayPal popup

Mandate re-checked again; PayPal-Request-Id = capture-<id>. Idempotent.

Refund a paid purchase

Mandate approver only. PayPal-Request-Id = refund-<id>.

exec: pm.test("401 for Submit a receipt", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

request.description:
Submit a receipt photo

Gemini reads it; duplicate (hash, exact and by meaning) and mandate checks run; the treasurer is notified.

exec: pm.test("401 for Approve a reimbursement", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

request.description:
Approve and send the PayPal payout

Approver only. Mandate re-checked; sender_batch_id = reimb-<id>; safe against double clicks.

exec: pm.test("401 for Reject a reimbursement", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

request.description: Reject a receipt
Payout status (asks PayPal while in flight)

exec: pm.test("401 for Record a subscription", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

request.description:
Record a member's dues subscription

The server reads the subscription back from PayPal and checks the plan before recording it.

exec: pm.test("401 for Send an invoice", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

request.description:
Send a drafted sponsor invoice

Treasurer only: this asks the sponsor for money.

exec: pm.test("401 for Check an invoice", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

request.description: Check whether a sponsor invoice was paid

exec: pm.test("401 for Create an API key", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

request.description:
Create an MCP API key

Treasurer only. The key is returned once; only its hash is stored.

exec: pm.test("401 for Revoke an API key", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

request.description: Revoke an MCP API key

Treasurer figures for the AG Studio agent

Read-only, from the same ledger the mandate engine checks: spend by event, mandates at or above a share of their cap, receipts waiting, blocked attempts, mandate health (approval rate, rules that fired most). Money in integer cents.

exec: pm.test("401 for AG Studio agent turn", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

request.description:
One AG Studio agent turn on Gemini

Called by the AG Studio adapter in the browser. Returns the model's text and tool calls; the browser runs the tools. The Gemini key stays on the server.
